latest_release.name: v13.40.0
latest_release.body:
* [13.x] Fix Paginator::links() return type by @dhrupo in https://github.com/laravel/framework/pull/62226
* [13.x] Fix updating JSON paths with arrays and collections on MySQL and MariaDB by @xurshudyan in https://github.com/laravel/framework/pull/62225
* [13.x] Use the write connection in BelongsToMany createOrFirst lookup by @xurshudyan in https://github.com/laravel/framework/pull/62223
* [13.x] Drop check constraints when dropping columns on SQL Server by @xurshudyan in https://github.com/laravel/framework/pull/62222
* [13.x] Centralize + improve tests for `InteractsWithData` by @inxilpro in https://github.com/laravel/framework/pull/62217
* [13.x] Fix Redis tagged cache flush blocking Redis when flushing many tags by @MohannadElemary in https://github.com/laravel/framework/pull/62215
* [13.x] Qualify dropped and renamed indexes with the table schema on PostgreSQL by @xurshudyan in https://github.com/laravel/framework/pull/62213
* [13.x] Reconnect after losing the connection during a transaction by @xurshudyan in https://github.com/laravel/framework/pull/62211
* [13.x] Add missing PostgreSQL full text languages by @xurshudyan in https://github.com/laravel/framework/pull/62210
* [13.x] Add Queue::whenJobRunsLongerThan by @jackbayliss in https://github.com/laravel/framework/pull/62141
* [13.x] Fix named arguments in Cookie::queue() by @xurshudyan in https://github.com/laravel/framework/pull/62246
* [13.x] Fix ImageFile::default() returning a plain File rule by @Marzaan in https://github.com/laravel/framework/pull/62244
* [13.x] Fix pagination contracts render() return type by @dhrupo in https://github.com/laravel/framework/pull/62242
* [13.x] Fix SQL Server ignoring orderBy on update and delete with limit by @xurshudyan in https://github.com/laravel/framework/pull/62239
* [13.x] Preserve error_get_last() for suppressed errors by @xurshudyan in https://github.com/laravel/framework/pull/62228
* Prepare reusable development environments for Amp orbs by @DGarbs51 in https://github.com/laravel/framework/pull/62231
* Allow `$middleware->replace()` to accept an array of replacements by @ziadoz in https://github.com/laravel/framework/pull/62230
* [13.x] Show released jobs as released in queue:work output by @jackbayliss in https://github.com/laravel/framework/pull/62180
* Add `$middleware->insertBefore()` and `$middleware->insertAfter()` helper methods by @ziadoz in https://github.com/laravel/framework/pull/62261
* [13.x] Reconnect the Cloud log socket after a failed write by @jamesdangercarpenter in https://github.com/laravel/framework/pull/62258
* [13.x] Dispatch `ScheduledTaskSkipped` when a task already ran on another server by @jackbayliss in https://github.com/laravel/framework/pull/62256
* [13.x] Fix forceIndex() generating invalid SQL on SQLite for PRIMARY and multiple indexes by @tharlei in https://github.com/laravel/framework/pull/62255
* [13.x] Add Schedule::whenTaskRunsLongerThan by @jackbayliss in https://github.com/laravel/framework/pull/62233
* [13.x] Roll back to savepoint on concurrency errors in nested transactions by @xurshudyan in https://github.com/laravel/framework/pull/62248
* [13.x] Fix `toResourceCollection()` on filtered collections by @xurshudyan in https://github.com/laravel/framework/pull/62266
* Fix lazily loaded images not being freed until garbage collection by @tamc in https://github.com/laravel/framework/pull/62265
* Bump stefanzweifel/git-auto-commit-action from 7.2.0 to 7.2.1 in the github-actions group by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/laravel/framework/pull/62288
* KeyGenerateCommand: improve help message about '--show' by @valerio-bozzolan in https://github.com/laravel/framework/pull/62286
* [13.x] Record failed batch jobs when the model is missing by @xurshudyan in https://github.com/laravel/framework/pull/62280
* [13.x] Fix broadcasting to multiple encrypted Pusher channels by @xurshudyan in https://github.com/laravel/framework/pull/62279
* [13.x] Fix Str::remove() rejecting a Traversab

detail.readme_excerpt: ## About Laravel > **Note:** This repository contains the core code of the Laravel framework. If you want to build an application using Laravel, visit the main [Laravel repository](https://github.com/laravel/laravel). Laravel is a web application framework with expressive, elegant syntax. We believe development must be an enjoyable, creative experience to be truly fulfilling. Laravel attempts to take the pain out of development by easing common tasks used in the majority of web projects, such as: - [Simple, fast routing engine](https://laravel.com/docs/routing). - [Powerful dependency injection container](https://laravel.com/docs/container). - Multiple back-ends for [session](https://laravel.com/docs/session) and [cache](https://laravel.com/docs/cache) storage. - Database agnostic [schema migrations](https://laravel.com/docs/migrations). - [Robust background job processing](https://laravel.com/docs/queues). - [Real-time event broadcasting](https://laravel.com/docs/broadcasting). Laravel is accessible, yet powerful, providing tools needed for large, robust applications. A superb combination of simplicity, elegance, and innovation gives you a complete toolset required to build any application with which you are tasked. ## Learning Laravel Laravel has the most extensive and thorough [documentation](https://laravel.com/docs) and video tutorial library of all modern web application frameworks, making it a breeze to get started with the framework. You can also check out [Laravel Learn](https://laravel.com/learn), where you will be guided through building a modern Laravel application. If you're not in the mood to read, [Laracasts](https://laracasts.com) contains thousands of video tutorials covering a range of topics including Laravel, modern PHP, unit testing, JavaScript, and more.
